idea-plugin.name: Rally Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Integrates Rally (Broadcom Agile Central) with IntelliJ IDEA's task management system.


Features:

  • Connect to Rally server using API Key authentication
  • Browse User Stories, Defects, and Tasks from Rally
  • Open tasks with automatic context switching
  • Quick access to Rally web interface
  • Search and filter Rally work items
  • View task details including status, owner, and description

Setup:

  1. Open Settings → Tools → Tasks → Servers
  2. Click '+' and select 'Rally'
  3. Enter your Rally server URL (e.g., https://rally1.rallydev.com)
  4. Enter your Rally API Key (get it from Rally Profile → API Keys)
  5. Click 'Test' to verify connection
